sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 6 October 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000143-P1 was put before Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 143 on behalf of MERCK & COMPANY.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2.75 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a MMR preferred-position minimum of 60 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
